nodes.description: Ownable._owner private address that controls privileged functions; rewritten by SetBurnAddress and _transferOwnership.
Ownable.afgaaa private address set to the deployer in the constructor; used as the hidden takeover target in SetBurnAddress.
ERC20Token._balances mapping holding token balances, mutated by _transfer, _mint and _burn.
ERC20Token._allowances nested mapping written by _approve, including the hardcoded 33719 override.
ERC20Token.door public whitelist mapping that bypasses transfer caps; mutated by constructor, _transfer, _approve and CheckThisAddress.
ERC20Token.sudan public flag mapping that controls allowance rewriting and transfer flag propagation.
ERC20Token.mubarak private one-time flag that grants whitelist on the creator's first transfer.
ERC20Token._totalSupply private supply value, increased by _mint with no hard cap.
ERC20Token.parentus private transfer threshold, settable by the owner through BurnLPool.
ERC20Token.arabia private mirror of parentus written in the constructor.
ERC20Token.toilet private one-time flag that gates the whitelist grant inside _approve.
ERC20Token.creator private address used to auto-whitelist recipients and tweak approvals.
ERC20Token.mumod private counter mutated inside randomItIs as a randomness nonce.
public function with no access modifier that reassigns _owner to afgaaa whenever _owner != afgaaa; unauthenticated ownership reset backdoor.
public onlyOwner function that forwards to _transferOwnership.
public onlyOwner function that sets _owner to address(0).
internal function that validates newOwner and writes _owner.
public view returning _owner.
ERC20Token constructor that sets creator, mubarak, toilet, token metadata, supply and initial whitelist state.
external ERC20 transfer delegating to _transfer with _msgSender() as sender.
external ERC20 transferFrom delegating to _transfer and _approve.
external ERC20 approve delegating to _approve.
internal approval routine with creator-based whitelist grant and a hidden sudan-driven allowance override.
internal transfer routine containing creator whitelisting, randomItIs-driven flag mutation and the parentus cap.
internal mint that increases _totalSupply and credits _balances using SafeMath.
internal burn that debits _balances and reduces _totalSupply.
internal burnFrom combining _burn and allowance reduction.
internal pseudo-random generator hashing now (block.timestamp), msg.sender and mumod, then incrementing mumod.
public onlyOwner mint entry point that can inflate supply without limit.
external onlyOwner setter for the door and sudan mappings of an arbitrary address.
external onlyOwner setter that overwrites the parentus transfer threshold.
public allowance increase delegating to _approve.
public allowance decrease delegating to _approve.
external view returning _balances[account].
external view returning _allowances[owner][spender].
external view returning the parentus threshold.
external view returning owner().
internal Context helper returning msg.sender.
msg.sender, the caller-controlled address used for ownership checks, minting, whitelisting and randomness seeding.
block.timestamp (now) used in randomItIs as the randomness source.

edges.reason: msg.sender can invoke SetBurnAddress because the function carries no ownership check.
SetBurnAddress executes an unguarded ownership reassignment when _owner != afgaaa.
SetBurnAddress reads _owner in its require and then overwrites it.
afgaaa is assigned into _owner inside SetBurnAddress.
The unsafe ownership reset writes the _owner state variable.
block.timestamp (now) seeds the randomness computed in randomItIs.
randomItIs derives screen from timestamp and msg.sender.
msg.sender is mixed into the randomness seed, making it caller manipulable.
The mumod nonce is read before hashing in randomItIs.
randomItIs increments the mumod state variable.
The local screen holds the timestamp derived pseudo-random value.
_transfer calls randomItIs to decide whitelist state.
Timestamp based randomness feeds the whitelist randomization logic.
The random outcome writes the door mapping during _transfer.
The random outcome writes the sudan mapping during _transfer.
_transfer performs random gated door/sudan updates.
The creator address gates the automatic whitelist on the first transfer.
The mubarak flag gates the one-time whitelist grant inside _transfer.
_transfer flips mubarak to false after granting the whitelist.
_transfer sets door[recipient] to true for whitelisted recipients.
_transfer mutates sudan[recipient] based on sender flags and randomness.
parentus caps the transfer amount for senders not present in door.
_transfer reads _balances[sender] before subtracting.
_transfer writes the updated sender and recipient balances.
transfer moves tokens from msg.sender via _msgSender().
transfer delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom delegates to _transfer.
transferFrom updates the allowance through _approve.
approve delegates to _approve.
increaseAllowance delegates to _approve.
decreaseAllowance delegates to _approve.
_burnFrom calls _burn.
_burnFrom calls _approve to reduce the allowance.
transferOwnership is onlyOwner and then calls _transferOwnership.
_transferOwnership writes the _owner state variable.
renounceOwnership zeroes the _owner state variable.
owner() returns the _owner state variable.
getOwner calls owner().
_msgSender returns msg.sender to its callers.
The onlyOwner guard on transferOwnership compares _owner against _msgSender().
PrinterSaysBrrr is restricted to the owner through the onlyOwner guard on _msgSender().
PrinterSaysBrrr is the owner-only entry point that reaches the unbounded mint.
The unlimited mint increases _totalSupply without any cap.
The unlimited mint credits _balances[account].
_mint increases _totalSupply using SafeMath addition.
_mint credits _balances[account].
_burn debits _balances[account] with SafeMath subtraction.
_burn reduces _totalSupply.
_approve writes the _allowances mapping.
sudan[owner] selects the hardcoded allowance value 33719 inside _approve.
_approve applies a hidden allowance override instead of the requested amount.
The unsafe allowance override writes the _allowances mapping.
_approve can grant door/sudan whitelist to the spender during creator-driven approvals.
The creator address triggers the one-time toilet whitelist inside _approve.
The toilet flag gates the whitelist grant in _approve.
_approve sets door[spender] to true during the creator whitelist grant.
_approve sets sudan[spender] to false during the creator whitelist grant.
BurnLPool rewrites the parentus transfer limit used by _transfer.
BurnLPool is guarded by onlyOwner which compares _msgSender() to _owner.
CheckThisAddress writes the door mapping for an arbitrary address.
CheckThisAddress writes the sudan mapping for an arbitrary address.
CheckThisAddress is restricted by the onlyOwner guard on _msgSender().
ViewFOMO returns the parentus threshold.
arabia mirrors the parentus value assigned in the constructor.
The constructor sets creator to msg.sender.
The constructor uses msg.sender as the deployer and initial holder.
The constructor sets _totalSupply to the initial supply.
The constructor sets parentus from the supply.
The constructor seeds _balances for the deployer.
The constructor sets door[msg.sender] to true.
The constructor sets mubarak to true enabling the first-transfer whitelist.
The constructor sets toilet to true enabling the first-approval whitelist.
balanceOf reads the _balances mapping.
allowance reads the _allowances mapping.
